en-US.description:
True Joy Birthing is the birth plan app built by a real doula, with plain-language explanations that actually hold up in a hospital, a shared space for you and your care team to prepare together, and tools that carry you from your first trimester through postpartum.

BUILD A BIRTH PLAN THAT WORKS WHEN IT MATTERS
 (1/3)
Walk through 9 sections covering labor, delivery, pain management, interventions, pushing, post-delivery, and newborn care. Every option comes with a plain-language explanation of what it means in a hospital setting. No generic checklists. No medical jargon. Just honest guidance from a doula who has been in the room.

Interactive birth plan builder with 9 comprehensive sections
Guided video walkthroughs for each section
Export a clean, branded PDF your care team can read in under 2 minutes
Pushing preferences and a personal safe word
Postpartum planning built right into your birth plan

TOOLS FOR EVERY STAGE

Contraction timer that tracks timing, duration, and patterns
Weekly pregnancy tips tailored to your due date
Wellness journal to check in on how you are feeling
Pregnancy timeline with milestones and reminders
Postpartum plan to prepare for life after birth

FIND AND CONNECT WITH PROVIDERS

Browse a marketplace of doulas and midwives in your area. Watch video introductions, read about their philosophy, and connect directly through the app.

SHARE YOUR PLAN WITH YOUR WHOLE TEAM

Invite your partner, doula, or midwife to view and collaborate on your plan. Everyone stays on the same page, literally.

FOR DOULAS AND MIDWIVES

True Joy Birthing Pro gives birth workers a professional toolkit:

Client management and visit tracking
Appointment scheduling and clinical notes
Contracts with e-signature and invoicing
Shared birth plan access with clients
Lead tracking and client pipeline
Newborn exams and prenatal visit documentation (midwives)
Birth summaries
Professional profile with video introduction

Free for moms. Pro tools for doulas and midwives.

ABOUT TRUE JOY BIRTHING

Founded by a birth doula who watched too many moms walk into hospitals unprepared, not because they didn't care, but because nobody gave them the real information in plain language. True Joy Birthing exists to close that gap.
 (2/3)
We don't give medical advice. We don't shame any birth path. We help you make informed choices and give you the words to stand by them.

review.notes:
True Joy Birthing is a birth plan and birth education app for pregnant parents, doulas, and midwives.

To test the app:
- Mom account: Create a new account (free) and select "Mom" as user type. The birth plan builder and guided videos are accessible immediately.
- Pro account (doula/midwife): Create a new account and select "Doula" or "Midwife." I gave you the Midwife login abut in the Sign-In information. Here is the Doula test login: demo.doula@truejoybirthing.com / DemoDoula2024!Pro features require a subscription (True Joy Pro). For a test Mom login: demo.mom@truejoybirthing.com / DemoMom2024!

Subscription details:
- Monthly: $29.99/month
- Annual: $274.99/year
- 14-day free trial included
- Subscribers can manage/cancel through Settings > Subscriptions on their device.

The app includes embedded video content (birth plan walkthroughs) hosted externally via Bunny CDN. These are educational videos, not user-generated content.

Privacy Policy: https://truejoybirthing.com/privacy/
Terms of Service: https://truejoybirthing.com/terms/
